title: Soulscorch Emissives
description: Adds emissive textures for the Soulscorch mod
body:
Since it is easier to put emissive textures as a resource pack, I made this for my upcoming mod, [Soulscorch](https://modrinth.com/mod/soulscorch), that updates the Soul Sand Valley biome. Arguably best for shaders. Requires Optifine (if on Forge) or [MoreMcmeta Emissive Textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/moremcmeta-emissive)

- Makes all of the added items emissive
- Soul Slag is emissive
- Soul Brewing Stand is emissive
- Lit and/or Powered Iron Bulb is emissive
- All of the added entites are emissive in some way
- The vanilla Brewing Stand is emissive to match the Soul Brewing Stand's emissivity
